triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Triage: lands in area:ux · domain:ui · Bug · p1 · pm:queue · size M; rationale: a cold Console load waits on five serial request hops before the app bundle is requested, so the page heading lands up to about 3.6 s after navigation on a busy runner (measured by the #38138 dev). Every cold page load pays this. It is also the measured root cause of the Live E2E timing flake **#38138** (p1), which ejected a PR from the merge queue, so this card inherits p1. Fetching the bundle as soon as the route names the app, in parallel with the boot reads, serves both the first-screen goal and the flake. Linked under topic **#38082** (控制台首屏 2.5 秒内打开). Answers seat repo:objectstack#1's `Request: triage` (7234497141). Recorded 2026-11-28T05:10Z.
